name.ja: 明示的再始動Krylovと内部固有値
name.en: Explicitly restarted Krylov and interior eigenvalues

caption.ja: 固有値比較に使う、保存した31×31 Dirichlet Laplacian。
caption.en: The saved 31 x 31 Dirichlet Laplacian used in the eigenvalue comparisons.

name.ja: 有限次元の行列固有値問題

note.ja: 主対象は31×31の固定対称行列の標準固有値問題です。行列の離散スペクトルを参照し、連続PDEの空間収束を検査したとはしません。
note.en: The primary case is a fixed 31 x 31 symmetric standard eigenproblem. Its discrete spectrum provides the reference; continuum PDE spatial convergence is not claimed.

equation_note.en: A fixed Dirichlet Laplacian of size 31, restart lengths 8 and 16, and at most 40 cycles. Compare the untransformed problem with shifts 0 and 950.

name.ja: 明示的再始動Krylovと内部固有値
name.en: Explicitly restarted Krylov and interior eigenvalues

note.ja: 固定長の明示的再始動とshift-invertを、元の固有値問題の残差と作用回数で比較します。
note.en: Explicit restarting and shift-invert are compared using original eigenproblem residuals and counted operator actions.

title.ja: 再始動/shift-invert：固定離散行列の閉スペクトル
title.en: Restarting and shift-invert: the closed spectrum of a fixed discrete matrix

assumptions.ja: 31×31 Dirichlet三重対角行列、h=1/32、再始動長8/16、shiftなし/0/950。参照はこの有限行列の固有値であり、格子細分化による連続PDE収束を認証しません。
assumptions.en: A fixed 31 x 31 Dirichlet tridiagonal matrix with h=1/32, restart lengths 8 and 16, and shifts none/0/950. The references are eigenvalues of this finite matrix, not a continuum PDE grid-convergence study.

note.ja: 単一対称実固有対だけ。暗黙再始動・Krylov-Schur・ロッキング・一般の非正規やクラスターは未実装。
note.en: One eigenpair of a real symmetric matrix only. No implicit restarting, Krylov-Schur, locking, or general nonnormal or clustered-spectrum capability is claimed.

reference_note.ja: 既知の正弦スペクトルと独立な全行列LAPACK。shift解・Krylov作用・元残差作用を別計数。
reference_note.en: The known discrete sine spectrum and an independent global LAPACK comparison. Shift-solve, Krylov and original-residual actions are counted separately.

method_note.ja: 二重MGS Arnoldiを単一Ritzベクトルから明示的に再始動。自前LUでshift線形解を求め、元の固有残差で停止。
method_note.en: Two-pass Arnoldi is explicitly restarted from one Ritz vector. Original LU routines perform the shifted solves, and stopping uses the original eigenproblem.
